title: ר' ברכיה
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rabbi Berekhiah: many expositions. Yoma 71a, in the name of Rabbi Abba; and Rabbi Abba bar Ilai. Another reading: and Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, in the name of Rav. In the name of Rabbi Abba bar Binah; in the name of Rabbi Avdimi of Haifa. Rabbi Abbahu said; in the name of Rabbi Avin Ish Nachum; and Rabbi Achai. And Rabbi Elazar: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Kilayim. And Rabbi Elazar, Rabbi Chelbo, and Ulla Beraya [ברייה; byname or relationship unresolved], in the name of Rabbi Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah chapter 2, halakhah 3, and chapter Ellu Megallechin, halakhah 7; also Rabbah, Shemini, end of chapter 11. And Rabbi Assi; in the name of Rav Assi; in the name of Rabbi Betzala. And Rabbi Zeira; Rabbi Chiyya of Kefar Techumin. In the name of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba: Yelammedenu, section Acharei Mot. In the name of Rabbi Chelbo; and Rabbi Chelbo of Tiva; and Chalfi bar Zevid. In the name of Rabbi Chama bar Chanina: Bereshit Rabbah, Vayetze, chapter 68. In the name of Rabbi Chunya of the house of Chavran. Rabbi Chanina ben Izka; and Rabbi Chanina, end of Kilayim. In the name of Rabbi Chisda. In the name of Rabbi Yehudah: Bereshit Rabbah, end of chapter 13; Jerusalem Talmud, end of Taanit chapter 3; Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 11. Rabbi Yudan Berabbi in his name; Rabbi Yudan bar Chanan in his name. And Rabbi Yehoshua ben Yair, in the name of Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair—requires examination. And Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, end of Kilayim. In the name of Rabbi Yochanan bar Naggara. And Rabbi Abbahu, in the name of Rabbi Yonatan: Midrash Kohelet, verse “He has made everything beautiful in its time.” And Rabbi Yaakov bar Bat Yaakov. In the name of Rabbi Yitzchak: Midrash Shmuel, chapter 20, and Midrash Ruth, chapter 2. In the name of Rabbi Yishmael bar Nachman. In the name of Rabbi Levi: Bereshit Rabbah, Vayetze, chapter 68. In the name of Rabbi Mattanah. In the name of Rabbi Akiva: Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 11. In the name of Rabbi Meir: Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 29. Ulla Beraya [ברייה; byname or relationship unresolved]. In the name of Rabbi Pappi; and Rabbi Parnakh. In the name of Kritzpah. In the name of Rav: Shekalim, chapter 1; Jerusalem Talmud, end of Berakhot, and Taanit chapter 3, halakhah 9. In the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman: Bikkurim chapter 1, halakhah 3. Rav Shmuel, his brother; Rabbi Shimon, his brother. In the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai: Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 29. In the name of Resh Lakish: Shekalim, chapter 2, and Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 34. Rabbi Shimon ben Yosini in his name. In the name of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel: Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 86. Rav Tanchum bar Chanilai in his name. Rabbi Tanchum bar Pappa and Rabbi Mana. His sons were sages.
